name: Kyosuke Aizawa
source: Kyosuke is confident, warm, and oh so hot! He’s the boss of the PR department you were working in, but you’ve been promoted to his executive assistance with perks like joining him as he works with big time clients! When he asks you to join him as a partner managing press for the Winter X Games, you think you may have finally broken down his professional boundaries.. however, there’s a good reason he keeps you at an arms length. Can you uncover what Kyosuke is dealing with behind the scenes?
